memory_and_runtime_contract.raw_input: One metric and bounded pages, decoder/operator state; neither raw matrix dimension is assumed resident. Exact replay replaces retained histories.
memory_and_runtime_contract.total_memory: Metadata, groups, native payloads, diagnostics and independently owned output can grow. Disabled enforcement provides no fixed total-RAM or process-RSS bound.
memory_and_runtime_contract.observable_owned_and_borrowed_bytes: Precisely accounted by ownership/lifetime; requested bytes and exposed borrowed views are distinct observations.
memory_and_runtime_contract.opaque_regex_and_selector_tables: Explicit estimates; hidden compilation/search temporaries and capacity peaks are not exact allocator accounting.
memory_and_runtime_contract.cancellation: Explicit caller cancellation/deadline checks are cooperative; a blocked foreign callback is not preempted.
memory_and_runtime_contract.allocation_failure: Resource accounting and explicit caller cancellation/deadlines only: all engine memory/sample/work/regex/cardinality/output/concurrency/time enforcement is disabled. Reached unavailable/full/failed provider backing returns a storage error. Actual allocator OOM may remain process-fatal.
memory_and_runtime_contract.temporary_backing: Provider-managed exact paged float-bit sorting and cleanup; specific reached unavailable/full errors, no core file creation or raw-history RAM fallback.
memory_and_runtime_contract.output: Synchronous provisional chunks commit/abort; an optional owned collector retains and accounts the complete answer until release.
memory_and_runtime_contract.ordinary_rust_panics: Contained at the C boundary under panic-unwind profiles; no unwinding escapes.

measured_retained_page_case.scope: Fixture timings, not a general throughput/RSS promise. Workspace is one accounted category, borrowed-view bytes are separate, and backing extent/traffic are not RAM.

ordering_and_compatibility.source_specified_order: Retained exactly where specified; canonical label-byte order only at approved source-unspecified boundaries.
ordering_and_compatibility.scheduled_policy_disposition: All 1248 complete comparisons pass under the original declared eight-case ordering policy; raw disagreements remain retained.
ordering_and_compatibility.sort_policy: 102858 policy-qualified comparisons; raw membership/order/bit classifications remain in original policy receipts. No global strict-raw-order claim.

approved_exceptions.nonadvancing_merge: Approved 11.A: changes()/resets() return a specific execution error when the reached float/histogram merge has equal timestamps and the pinned source loop cannot advance. Earlier operand acquisition and errors retain precedence.
approved_exceptions.label_encoding: Approved 17.A: every materialized label name/value must be shorter than 16777216 bytes. Reject the exactly-2^24-byte upstream corrupted-length boundary. This is per-field representation validity, not enabled query resource enforcement.

limits_of_evidence: Finite source-bound corpora do not prove equivalence for every possible input.
Counts overlap; no sum is presented as a count of unique queries.
Original AST witnesses are not node visitation, branch coverage or proof of every feature interaction.
Retained source-equivalent cohorts keep their actual source and binary identities.
Historical Miri used ABI2; no complete current ABI3 Miri qualification is claimed.
GNU/QEMU target checks do not qualify all operating systems or hardware environments.
Declared independent source assessments cover the standalone scope; live storage/API/rules/Cloud and platform/operational qualification remain subsequent stages.
remaining_integrations: Go Cloud distributed query contract and implementation
Independent rules, lifecycle/templates and Netdata alert integration
Platform, failure, performance and operational qualification

control_and_accounting_qualification.followup_reuse_assessment: The only production differences from885 are the existing control/work checks while reverse-enqueuing Call arguments, and independent accounting of position-prefix bytes when cancellation is suppressed after a returned provider error. Enqueue order, inherited histogram flags, position arithmetic, diagnostic text and provider-error precedence are preserved. Neither correction changes parsing, numeric algorithms, raw paging, evaluation order or ABI declarations. Two causal regressions and the compilation/annotation/statistics/provider/C ownership groups qualify these changes across both native/foreign builds and Rust1.91. Broader first-correction and older numerical/frontend panels remain attributed to their actual source/binary checkpoints.
control_and_accounting_qualification.assessment: Independent whole-core scopes and focused correction assessments found no remaining verified blocker; see the shared README for qualified scope and limitations.
